svg.text: J1: Accepts 5 V for charging only.
USB present holds the radio power off.
R1: Identifies a USB-C power sink on CC1.
Allows either cable orientation with R2.
R2: Identifies a USB-C power sink on CC2.
Allows either cable orientation with R1.
U2: Charges the cell at nominal 300 mA.
Manages USB input and the SYS power path.
R3: Programs U2 ISET for nominal 300 mA.
C1: Filters USB5V at the charger input.
C2: Filters VBAT at the charger BAT pin.
J2: Pin 1 is GND; pin 2 is battery positive.
R4: Limits current through red LED1.
Connects VBAT to the LED anode path.
LED1: Lights when U2 pulls CHARGE_STAT low.
Indicates charger status, not BLE status.
R8: Selects the nominal 4.1 V charge target.
Sets U2's combined VSET / ILIM mode.
R9: Provides the fixed bias on U2 TS input.
U5 supplies the separate temperature gate.
C8: Decouples the charger's SYS output.
The radio regulator uses VBAT, not SYS.
C9: Filters noise at the PROG / ISET node.
Bluetooth HID, controls and 3.3 V UART programming
U1: Runs the Bluetooth HID shutter firmware.
Includes flash, crystal and RF antenna.
C5: Shunts fast 3.3 V supply noise to GND.
Local bypass for the radio module.
SW2: Press grounds SHUTTER on GPIO4.
Firmware sends a BLE Volume-Up keypress.
SW3: Press grounds PAIR on GPIO5.
Hold for 3 seconds to request pairing.
R7: Limits current from GPIO6 into LED2.
Protects the LED and GPIO output.
LED2: Firmware controls this red LED via GPIO6.
J3: 1: RX GPIO20; 2: GND; 3: TX GPIO21.
SW4: Grounds GPIO9 for ROM download mode.
Hold BOOT while pressing / releasing RESET.
SW5: Grounds module EN to reset the ESP32-C3.
Release after selecting normal / BOOT mode.
J3 programming: battery ON; USB-C unplugged.
Programmer J5: straight-through cable; manual BOOT / RESET.
Battery cutoff and automatic charge temperature window
SW1: ON feeds BATTERY_OK through R5 to enable.
OFF grounds that path; charging still works.
R5: Feeds REG_EN from the power-switch output.
Lets Q1 override enable when USB is present.
Q1: USB5V turns this 2N7002 MOSFET on.
Pulls REG_EN low, disabling radio power.
R6: Bleeds USB5V when the cable is removed.
Keeps Q1 gate low without USB input.
U3: Regulates the battery to fixed 3.3 V.
Runs only when REG_EN permits radio power.
L1: Transfers energy between U3 switch nodes.
C3: Supplies switching current on VBAT.
Works with input bulk capacitor C11.
C11: Adds battery-side energy storage for U3.
Complements C3 at the power input.
C13: Filters fast noise at U3's VBAT input.
C4: Smooths the regulated 3.3 V supply.
C12: Adds output storage for load transients.
Complements C4 on the 3.3 V rail.
U4: Monitors VBAT; nominal threshold 3.08 V.
Drives BATTERY_OK low below that threshold.
C6: Decouples U4's battery supply locally.
Reduces fast noise at the supervisor.
U5: Allows charging inside the set window.
Must be thermally coupled to the cell.
C7: Decouples USB5V at U5 supply pin.
Filters supply noise for the comparators.
R10: Sets U5's nominal hot limit near 36 C.
Charging is disabled above this limit.
R11: Sets U5's nominal cold limit near 5 C.
Charging is disabled below this limit.
R12: Pulls U5's open-drain outputs high.
TEMP_OK falls low outside the safe window.
R13: Pulls U2's active-low charge enable high.
Defaults charging off when Q2 is off.
Q2: TEMP_OK high turns this 2N7002 on.
Pulls CHARGE_DISABLE low to allow charging.
